metas.name: Hoop Dreams
metas.description: Captures the American dream as a system that uses kids up. Two Chicago teenagers filmed over five years chasing basketball as a way out, as school, family, money and injury keep intervening.

metas.name: Senna
metas.description: Captures speed, faith and charisma, entirely from archive. Ayrton Senna's career built only from period footage and voices — rivalry with Prost, Brazil on his helmet, in-car laps that feel like prayer at 300 km/h.

metas.name: Free Solo
metas.description: Captures a man whose relationship to fear is simply different from yours. Alex Honnold prepares to climb El Capitan without ropes while the filmmakers — his friends — argue on camera about whether filming changes the odds.

metas.name: When We Were Kings
metas.description: Captures Ali as a political and verbal artist at his peak. The Rumble in the Jungle, Zaire 1974: training footage, a music festival, Mobutu's stadium, and Ali talking everyone, including himself, into belief.

metas.name: The Wrestler
metas.description: Captures a body that only has value inside the ring. An ageing, hearing-damaged wrestler on supermarket shifts, trying with his daughter, and finding the crowd is the one place the world still makes sense to him.

metas.name: Raging Bull
metas.description: Captures self-destruction in a family kitchen as much as a ring. Jake LaMotta's jealousy and violence at home filmed with the same intensity as the fights; he can take any punch except accountability.

metas.name: Minding the Gap
metas.description: Captures the moment a documentarian has to point the camera at himself. Bing Liu films his skateboarder friends in their rust-belt hometown over years, then slowly realises the film is about the violence they all grew up in — including his own.

metas.name: Icarus
metas.description: Captures a documentary swallowed by its own story: Fogel films himself doping to expose how easy cheating is, but his Russian scientist accomplice sits at the centre of a state doping programme, and the film becomes his escape plan.

metas.name: AlphaGo
metas.description: Captures the exact historical moment a machine did something its makers couldn't explain. DeepMind's system against Lee Sedol in Seoul, filmed in both camps; Move 37 lands and the human experts go quiet.

metas.name: Diego Maradona
metas.description: Captures fame as a hostage situation where the hostage keeps scoring goals. Kapadia builds Maradona's Naples years entirely from archive: adored as a god, pulled into the Camorra's orbit, collapsing under a worship no person could survive.
